name: Uemura Shin
source:
Akane's childhood friend from their kindergarten days. He's in his first year of employment at Nextroid, the top corporation of robot development. He's smart, cool-headed and very serious. He hasn't seen Akane since they graduated high school. For reasons unknown, he appears to have some concerns about Sakuya.

[Translation of the [URL=http://tetrascope.skr.jp/sakuya/chara_shin.html]official website's character profile[/URL].]
